name: Fidelis Memory
tagline: Recall original notes from a local-first agent memory store
description: Fidelis gives Cline four MCP tools for local-first memory recall, direct queries, service health, and context-sensitive orientation. Its default retrieval path makes no LLM call and returns stored passages verbatim rather than rephrasing them.

install.notes: Prerequisites for memory-backed operations: Python 3.10+, uv/uvx, Ollama, and the nomic-embed-text model. Before first use, run `uvx --from fidelis-memory==0.2.0 fidelis init` once to install and start the local Fidelis service. Remove that service with `uvx --from fidelis-memory==0.2.0 fidelis init --uninstall`.
